name: Lightning Elemental

actions.name: Lightning Strike
actions.effect: Target must pass PHYS save or be stunned until end of their next turn.

actions.name: Chain Lightning
actions.effect: Hits primary target, then arcs to up to 3 additional targets within 6m of each other. Each must pass PHYS save for half damage.

actions.name: Thunderclap
actions.effect: All creatures within 3m must pass PHYS save or be deafened and pushed 3m.

reactions.name: Discharge
reactions.effect: When hit by a melee attack with a metal weapon, the attacker takes 3d8 lightning damage.

reactions.name: Flash Step
reactions.effect: When targeted by an attack, the elemental teleports up to 9m in a flash of lightning. The attack misses.

traits.name: Lightning Form
traits.desc: Can move through spaces as narrow as 2cm. Moves at double speed. Metal armor provides no defense bonus against this creature.

traits.name: Charged
traits.desc: Creatures within 3m that are wearing metal armor take 1d8 lightning damage at the start of their turn.

lore: Lightning Elementals are living storms compressed into a vaguely humanoid form. They crackle with barely contained energy, striking with the speed and fury of a thunderbolt. Their presence is heralded by the smell of ozone and static electricity.
